availability.message: Stack CLI 0.5.2 is available through GitHub Releases, Homebrew, Aqua, and Cargo. Cargo installs the stack-diagram-cli source package using Rust 1.85 or newer and registry-only dependencies.

versioning.prereleasePolicy: GitHub prerelease only; never selected by default by package managers
versioning.minimumSupportedVersionSource: Legacy release-manifest minimumSupportedCliVersion is set to the release version for schema compatibility; it does not authorize self-update

reproducibility.gzipHeader: no original filename or wall-clock timestamp

unsupported.reason: No release build or smoke-test lane is defined.

unsupported.platform: Linux with musl libc, including Alpine Linux

channels.owns: canonical immutable binary archives with generated shell completions and manual page, release manifest, checksums, signature bundle, SBOMs, and provenance
channels.updatePolicy: Verify and manually install the desired immutable GitHub release; never overwrite a package-manager-owned binary

channels.owns: formula metadata, GitHub archive URL and SHA-256 mapping, completion and manual placement, install, upgrade, and uninstall lifecycle on current Homebrew tier-1 hosts
channels.updatePolicy: Homebrew owns upgrades; stack never replaces its own executable

channels.owns: the stack-diagram-cli crates.io source package and registry-only locked dependency graph; installs the stack binary with Rust 1.85 or newer
channels.updatePolicy: Cargo owns upgrades; stack never replaces its own executable

channels.owns: owner registry metadata, immutable registry revision, version pinning, and SHA-256 lock mapped to canonical GitHub archives
channels.updatePolicy: Aqua owns upgrades; stack never replaces its own executable

releaseActivation: tag equals v plus the Cargo package version
all tier-1 archives build from the tagged commit
all archive contents and metadata names match this contract
all checksums, Sigstore bundles, SBOMs, and provenance verify
stack --version, help, init, check, and render pass on each target
generated shell completion source matches the archived bash, zsh, and fish files
generated manual page matches the archived stack.1 file
the release manifest records minimumSupportedCliVersion and each verified channel
verification.rollback: Never replace a tag or asset. Mark a broken release as withdrawn, remove it from default update resolution, restore package-manager metadata to the last verified release, and publish a new patch version.
